name: Cozy Gamer
eras: 2020 onward, accelerated by pandemic-era Animal Crossing: New Horizons
places: in-game spaces as much as real ones
garments: plushies and knit accessories mirroring in-game items

media.title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons (2020)
media.note: the single biggest driver of the aesthetic's 2020 explosion

media.title: Stardew Valley (2016)
media.note: an earlier touchstone for the low-stakes, nature-focused game palette

reacts_against: high-stress, competitive gaming culture's visual language (dark, aggressive, red-black); cozy gamer aesthetics are deliberately soft and low-stakes.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Houseplants, mechanical keyboards, plushies, pixel art, warm fairy lights, wood textures, pegboards, mugs
wiki_facts.key_colours: Sage green, cream, soft brown, pastel pink, warm white

wiki_facts.key_values: Escapism, comfort, mindfulness, slow living, soft productivity

findings: mostly muted — about 70% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
